v0.1.description:
Finally releasing! Ping me on discord (`@xlander36` or `@Red (xLander)`) and I'll be happy to help with setup or to address any bug reports/suggestions.  

## Locations
* Chapter completions
* Reaching each map in a chapter
* Health and HEV Chargers: can be disabled with `chargesanity` in YAML
* Weapon pickups: first time picking up each weapon. Includes HEV suit

## Items
* Chapter Unlocks
* Weapon Unlocks: `weapons_per_level` defaults to off, but can be used to make weapons randomize per chapter
* HEV Suit and Flashlight Unlocks
* Progressive Aux Power: configurable minimum in YAML
* Vehicle Keys: By default just 2 items, one for the buggy and one for the airboat. `vehicle_keys_per_level` can be toggled to randomize keys per chapter
* Airboat gun and buggy gun unlocks
* Extra "Melee Throw" ability: when unlocked, can right click to yeet your crowbar to do 4x damage of a normal swing.
* Filler items: Ammo caches, medkits, batteries
* "Fun" Traps: Many from the original half-life apworld make a second appearance, alongside some new ones like "Manhack Swarm" and "Junk Trap" (which drops a random selection props on you due to the power of Source engine. Thanks Gabe)
* Mega Bot Swarm Trap: Default off, turn this on only if you've got a strong enough pc to handle every biped in the game spawning on you at once as bots with crowbars. Highly recommend though, very fun in tight spaces.

## Setup
* Install the apworld and Half-Life 2 (Use Proton Hotfix if on Linux)
* Open the Half-Life 2 Client and run /install
* Restart Steam and then launch Half-Life 2 Archipelago from your library. If you're on Linux, make sure to go to Compatibility and choose the same Proton as your game install
* Connect to your multiworld via the HL2 Client
* Enjoy!

## Known Issues
* Super Gravity Gun check is gated behind having the 3rd progressive gravity gun. This is leftover from old logic and is properly accounted for, but is planned to be changed. The trace line will still trace to it, but you won't be able to pick it up without super gravity gun access.

_NOTE: While this has been tested thoroughly by multiple people (Thanks `@Iris` and `@Sirknobbles` for helping me test, you guys are awesome!), it is still an early build. Expect some issues to crop up: the occasional logic bug or other unexpected behavior. If you too want to test early unstable builds and play fun testing asyncs, ping me on discord and I'll add you to our testing server._
v0.1.title: Half-Life 2 Archipelago Alpha v0.1
